Ragdoll Escape — Overhaul Architecture & Controls

1. Anatomical 2D Humanoid Ragdoll

Multi-layered capsule limbs with upper/lower arms, gloved hands, knees, sneakers, jacket torso, and an expressive face (tracking pupils, eyebrows, reactive mouth) driven by PD balance springs and IK reach.

2. Interactive World Physics

Grab and swing on suspended ropes, push/pull physics crates onto pressure plates, pull mechanical levers to open blast doors, hang onto ledges, and launch off seesaw catapults.

3. 4 Illustrated Multi-Layer Worlds

Custom parallax art across Sunlit Mega-Warehouse, Skyline Construction, Quantum Bio-Lab, and Volcanic Foundry—complete with sunbeams, clouds, cranes, bubbles, and magma glow.

4. 12 Multi-Route Campaign Levels

Gradual EASY → MEDIUM → HARD progression with upper secret routes, physics puzzles, 36 Golden Bolts, 12 Hidden Gems, and 8 unlockable character outfits.
